title: What happened to your data
lead: Not "fully private": here is exactly what leaves your phone, where it goes, and what we keep.
can1: The text of a request while it is processed, with your name, case number and addresses replaced by placeholders before any model call.
can2: Your private agent sees the masked case as plain text while it works, and keeps a masked copy as its memory.
can3: The ledger: which model ran, when, how many bytes, how many IDs were masked.
can4: Letter images, only as ciphertext if you save them.
cannot1: Your saved case: it is encrypted on this device and never uploaded as a whole.
cannot2: Audio: Dossierly never receives or stores it.
cannot3: Model training: your content goes to Anthropic's API, which does not train on it by default. Generated test letters may go to Meta's models; your own content never does.
vaultBody: Your case is encrypted in this browser. For new cases, a non-exportable device key protects the saved data. Anyone using this unlocked browser profile may be able to open it.
vaultCodes: Email codes let you return to your account. They do not unlock older encrypted cases or recover data removed from this browser.
deleteBody: Destroys the encryption key and wipes the case, letters and wrap-ups from this device. This cannot be undone. To also erase the server ledger and your account, email gabriel@larinova.com.
deleteButton: Delete my case from this device
ledgerIntro: Every model call made for you and every network request your agent attempted, each entry hashed onto the one before. Change any row and the chain stops verifying.
emptyEgress: Your agent has not made any network requests yet.
emptyAll: Nothing recorded yet. Use any feature and it appears here.
runsIntro: Model calls for your case. {calls} calls · {tokens} tokens · {cached} served from cache.
